title: Day counter and  coordinates
body:
☀ Day Counter + Coordinates HUD

Displays the current world day and your real-time 
coordinates (X, Y, Z) above the hotbar.

✦ Works on existing worlds — just drop the zip 
  into your world's datapacks folder and run /reload
✦ Day counter matches the F3 menu exactly
✦ Updates automatically when sleeping
✦ Compatible with Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric & Vanilla)
